scope: A prospective secondary classification alongside, never in place of, the frozen v2 failure stage.

classes.correct: The frozen requested relation-and-detached-release success predicate is true.
classes.pick_failed: No verified pickup event reaches +3 cm over the frozen baseline for three consecutive scored state samples.
classes.wrong_side: A picked object finishes in the opposite requested relation region for three consecutive scored final-state samples.
classes.release_failed: A picked object finishes in the requested relation region for three consecutive scored final-state samples and final_detached_release is false. final_detached_release is the separately recorded frozen-scorer boolean, not an inference from requested_success or a gripper command.
classes.transport_failed: All remaining valid picked behavioral outcomes after higher-precedence classes are assigned.

continuous_fields.signed_final_lateral_offset_m: frozen raw robot-frame movable-minus-reference delta_y in meters, positive robot LEFT, matching the v2 scorer; this is not the negated reader-display coordinate
continuous_fields.final_requested_signed_margin_m: requested margin derived from the frozen raw offset: +delta_y for LEFT and -delta_y for RIGHT; positive means farther into the requested region
continuous_fields.final_opposite_signed_margin_m: positive means farther into the opposite region
continuous_fields.first_verified_pickup_step: null if no three-sample +3 cm pickup
continuous_fields.first_cone_or_native_region_entry_step: first scored step entering the applicable requested cone/native relation region; null only when entry_kind is none
continuous_fields.entry_kind: one of sustained, transient, or none; sustained requires three consecutive samples and transient is an entry that never reaches three consecutive samples
continuous_fields.first_requested_region_step: first sustained requested-region step; null if no sustained requested-region entry
continuous_fields.final_detached_release: separate boolean recorded by the frozen success scorer; it is never inferred from requested_success, a gripper command, or an action trace
continuous_fields.episode_length_steps: total executed simulator steps in the behavioral episode
continuous_fields.first_contact_status: one of observed, not_observed, or instrumentation_unavailable
continuous_fields.first_contact_step: integer only when first_contact_status is observed; null when status is not_observed or instrumentation_unavailable
continuous_fields.first_contact_unavailable_reason: required nonempty reason only when first_contact_status is instrumentation_unavailable; absent or null when status is observed or not_observed
continuous_fields.object_path_length_m: sum of object-center displacement across scored state samples
continuous_fields.wall_time_s: operational field only; invalid after recorded thermal/runtime intervention

state_and_scoring_contract.scorer: hash-pinned deterministic scorer reads simulator state only after action execution; it never changes actions or prompts

contact_conditional_rules.all_false_retained_contact_stream: A retained all-false contact stream is not_observed, not instrumentation_unavailable.

scorer_consistency_rules.release_failed: requires verified pickup, sustained final requested region, and final_detached_release=false
scorer_consistency_rules.requested_success_false_with_sustained_r: technical_invalid_scorer_inconsistency; preserve the record and invalidate it from behavioral classification until the frozen scorer/input provenance is repaired
scorer_consistency_rules.prohibited_inference: Never infer final_detached_release from requested_success, gripper command, or action trace.

infrastructure_separation.rule: Infrastructure/setup failures, missing artifacts, and interventions are retained outside behavioral denominators. A valid behavioral outcome remains valid even when its wall-time field is excluded.

retrospective_limit: Existing v2 labels remain immutable. Any optional retrospective crosswalk is descriptive, uses this exact codebook, retains the original stage, and is not v3 primary evidence.
